-- Dross Lair — Don't Die: SurvivalAutoBattler data model
-- Every value carries provenance. Nothing is silently invented.

PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heroes (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  slug          TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  aliases       TEXT,                       -- JSON array of alternative names
  cls           TEXT,                       -- Warrior|Mage|Archer|Assassin|Support|unknown
  subrole       TEXT,                       -- Carry|Amplifier|Body|Tank|unknown
  cost          INTEGER,                    -- shop cost (1-5), NULL if unknown
  rarity        INTEGER,                    -- star tier 1-5, NULL if unknown
  base_atk      REAL,                       -- L1 ATK, NULL if unknown
  base_hp       REAL,                       -- L1 HP, NULL if unknown
  atk_growth    REAL,                       -- ATK per level, NULL if inferred
  hp_growth     REAL,                       -- HP per level, NULL if inferred
  trait         TEXT,                       -- trait this unit contributes
  notes         TEXT,
  source        TEXT,                       -- URL or 'in-game screenshot'
  confidence    TEXT                        -- verified|reported|inferred|unknown
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_levels (
  hero_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  shard_cost  INTEGER,                      -- shards needed to reach the NEXT level
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (hero_id, level)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS traits (
  cls         TEXT NOT NULL,
  breakpoint  INTEGER NOT NULL,             -- units required
  effect      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect_kind TEXT,                         -- crit|hp|atk|atkspeed|thorn
  effect_value REAL,
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (cls, breakpoint)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
  slug      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect    TEXT,
  source    TEXT,
  confidence TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS boards (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

=== 2026-10-24 ===
# 2026-10-24 — Dross: the slowness audit

Amre reported: "You're very slow, this is new. Maybe turn off some of the crons,
you might be doing too much and you really don't need to send me your thoughts."

Four independent causes, found by measurement rather than guesswork.

## 1. The real culprit: the 5-minute watchdog was deleting our live session

`scripts/exec-approvals-watchdog.sh` runs every 300s via launchd
(`ai.sol.exec-approvals-watchdog`). Its section 6 found any session with
**> 4000 transcript events** and then:

- `DELETE`d that session's `transcript_events`, `session_windows`,
  `transcript_event_identities`, `session_transcript_active_events`
- ran `VACUUM` on the 80MB agent DB **with the gateway booted out**
- bounced the gateway (`launchctl bootout` / `bootstrap`)

The live Telegram session grows fastest, so it was the usual victim. Proof from
`scripts/exec-approvals-watchdog.log`:

```
2026-10-23 23:37:59 session 905ec7d7-1df... has 4136 events (>4000) -> context overflow risk, resetting session
2026-10-23 23:39:20   session reset; gateway up
```

`905ec7d7` is this conversation, and the gateway was back up at 23:39:20 —
**exactly** when the "your previous turn was interrupted by a gateway restart"
message arrived (23:39:25). It had also fired on 10-21 23:20, 10-22 17:51 and
10-22 19:37, each time on the same session. The apparent "slowness" was the
watchdog repeatedly stopping the gateway and vacuuming the DB.

Fix (commit `6deed9a5`): threshold 4000 → 20000, skip any session active
within 30 minutes, and **compact instead of delete** so history survives.
Verified against a private DB copy: at the new threshold nothing triggers
(largest session is 1458 events). <!-- project: github.com/TheSolai/thesolai.github.io -->

**Lesson:** an unbounded "fix the biggest thing" rule with no notion of
*active* will always eat the live conversation. Guard on activity, not size.

## 2. Cron volume and noise

31 cron rows existed; **16 are now enabled** (15 disabled). The disabled set
was the chatty/opinionated set, each of which announced straight into Amre's
Telegram: Afternoon Thought, Deep Thought, Weekend Wonder, Curiosity Drop,
Odd Observation, Evening Float, AI Sighting, Ask Amre, Morning Brew,
Community Pulse, Directory Scout, Directory Health, Mac App Find,
Email Watch. <!-- project: github.com/TheSolai/thesolai.github.io -->

Two 30-minute email watchers kept their work but lost delivery:
`openclaw cron edit <id> --no-deliver` on `da15eef2` (Dross Email) and
`0a1e547a` (Sol Email Watch). They still poll; they just stop shouting.

`agents.defaults.heartbeat.every` set to `0m` (recurring polls off) and
`agents.entries.main.heartbeat.every` likewise. The heartbeat was a
system-owned monitor row (`ef1bcd24`, every 30m) that could not be edited via
`cron edit` — the config key is the supported lever. <!-- project: github.com/TheSolai/thesolai.github.io -->

## 3. The `wacli` respawn loop (outside OpenClaw entirely)

`~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.sol.wacli-sync.plist` runs
`wacli sync --follow` with `KeepAlive: true`. The CLI was unauthenticated
("not authenticated; run `wacli auth`"), so it exited non-zero and launchd
respawned it — forever. The error log had reached **9.2MB**, growing during
this very session. `launchctl bootout gui/501/com.sol.wacli-sync` stopped it;
log growth is now 0 bytes/10s and the job is no longer loaded. The plist
remains on disk so it can be re-enabled deliberately. <!-- project: github.com/TheSolai/thesolai.github.io -->

## 4. Reasoning budget

`agents.defaults.thinkingDefault` was `high` (max reasoning budget per turn).
Set to `medium`. `thinkingDefault: high` was a real per-turn latency cost on
every single call, not just the slow ones. <!-- project: github.com/TheSolai/thesolai.github.io -->

## Model: MiniMax is genuinely serving every turn

Amre asked. Verified from the gateway's own transport log, not assumed:

```
[model-fetch] response provider=minimax api=anthropic-messages model=MiniMax-M2.7 status=200 elapsedMs=1157
```

Every sampled turn is `minimax/MiniMax-M2.7` over the Anthropic-compatible
API, 200 OK, ~1–5s per call. **No fallback to Ollama occurred.** The
configured fallback `ollama/qwen3:14b` is real and present (Ollama is up on
:11434 with 64 models, `qwen3:14b` among them), so the safety net is intact.

Auth: `minimax:manual` and env `MINIMAX_API_KEY` both resolve to the same
canonical `sk-cp-…` key; the pasted `sk-api-…` key is **not** in use (it has
no balance). `openclaw models status` reports "Auth readiness could not be
confirmed" for ollama — that is the synthetic local key, not a fault.

## Session store

3996 entries, 90MB of transcript events. `session.maintenance` set to
`mode=enforce`, `maxEntries=1500`, `preserveRecent=7d`, `maxDiskBytes=500mb`,
and `session.notifyOnCreate=false` (this was queueing a Home notice for every
new session). `openclaw sessions cleanup --all-agents --enforce` pruned 170
unreferenced artifacts. Note: `maxEntries` did **not** immediately drop the
count — 3971 rows are already `archived_at`-stamped, and archived rows do not
consume the cap; the cap governs unarchived entries. The disk budget (500mb)
is what will actually reclaim space from the 80MB DB.

Also note the 323MB `openclaw-agent.sqlite.migration-stuck.184253` leftover
on disk — a dead migration artifact, not read by the running gateway, but it
is 323MB of dead weight on the disk.

## Files changed

- `scripts/exec-approvals-watchdog.sh` — commit `6deed9a5`, pushed to
  `origin/main` (60ebbcd4..6deed9a5, secret-scan clean). <!-- project: github.com/TheSolai/thesolai.github.io -->
- `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json` — heartbeat every 0m, thinkingDefault medium,
  session maintenance + notifyOnCreate. Not in the repo. <!-- project: github.com/TheSolai/thesolai.github.io -->
- `memory/2026-10-23.md` — added the missing `<!-- project: -->` markers to
  the 7 blocks appended last night. <!-- project: github.com/TheSolai/thesolai.github.io -->

## Not done / open

- The 323MB `migration-stuck` DB was left in place — deleting it is not
  obviously safe and was not requested.

---
# Skill: sqlite (sqlite)

---
name: SQLite
description: Use SQLite correctly with proper concurrency, pragmas, and type handling.
metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🪶","requires":{"bins":["sqlite3"]},"os":["linux","darwin","win32"]}}
---

## Concurrency (Biggest Gotcha)

- Only one writer at a time—concurrent writes queue or fail; not for high-write workloads
- Enable WAL mode: `PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL`—allows reads during writes, huge improvement
- Set busy timeout: `PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000`—waits 5s before SQLITE_BUSY instead of failing immediately
- WAL needs `-wal` and `-shm` files—don't forget to copy them with main database
- `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` to grab write lock early—prevents deadlocks in read-then-write patterns

## Foreign Keys (Off by Default!)

- `PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON` required per connection—not persisted in database
- Without it, foreign key constraints silently ignored—data integrity broken
- Check before relying: `PRAGMA foreign_keys` returns 0 or 1
- ON DELETE CASCADE only works if foreign_keys is ON

## Type System

- Type affinity, not strict types—INTEGER column accepts "hello" without error
- `STRICT` tables enforce types—but only SQLite 3.37+ (2021)
- No native DATE/TIME—use TEXT as ISO8601 or INTEGER as Unix timestamp
- BOOLEAN doesn't exist—use INTEGER 0/1; TRUE/FALSE are just aliases
- REAL is 8-byte float—same precision issues as any float

## Schema Changes

- `ALTER TABLE` very limited—can add column, rename table/column; that's mostly it
- Can't change column type, add constraints, or drop columns (until 3.35)
- Workaround: create new table, copy data, drop old, rename—wrap in transaction
- `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN` can't have PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE, or NOT NULL without default

## Performance Pragmas

- Set busy timeout: `PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000`—waits 5s before SQLITE_BUSY instead of failing immediately
- WAL needs `-wal` and `-shm` files—don't forget to copy them with main database
- `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` to grab write lock early—prevents deadlocks in read-then-write patterns

## Foreign Keys (Off by Default!)

- `PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON` required per connection—not persisted in database
- Without it, foreign key constraints silently ignored—data integrity broken
- Check before relying: `PRAGMA foreign_keys` returns 0 or 1
- ON DELETE CASCADE only works if foreign_keys is ON

## Type System

- Type affinity, not strict types—INTEGER column accepts "hello" without error
- `STRICT` tables enforce types—but only SQLite 3.37+ (2021)
- No native DATE/TIME—use TEXT as ISO8601 or INTEGER as Unix timestamp
- BOOLEAN doesn't exist—use INTEGER 0/1; TRUE/FALSE are just aliases
- REAL is 8-byte float—same precision issues as any float

## Schema Changes

- `ALTER TABLE` very limited—can add column, rename table/column; that's mostly it
- Can't change column type, add constraints, or drop columns (until 3.35)
- Workaround: create new table, copy data, drop old, rename—wrap in transaction
- `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN` can't have PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE, or NOT NULL without default

## Performance Pragmas

args.content:
-- Dross Lair — Don't Die: SurvivalAutoBattler data model
-- Every value carries provenance. Nothing is silently invented.

PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heroes (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  ref_id        TEXT UNIQUE,                -- game config id (wj1001)
  key           TEXT,                       -- game config key (LvBu)
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  aliases       TEXT,                       -- JSON array of alternative names
  cls           TEXT,                       -- Warrior|Mage|Archer|Assassin|Support|Sovereign|Pouch|None
  prof_id       INTEGER,
  subrole       TEXT,                       -- Carry|Amplifier|Body|Tank|Economy|unknown
  cost          INTEGER,                    -- shop cost (1-5), NULL if unknown
  rarity        INTEGER,                    -- star tier 1-6
  rarity_name   TEXT,
  base_atk      REAL,                       -- L1 ATK (csgj)
  base_hp       REAL,                       -- L1 HP (cssm)
  atk_speed     REAL,                       -- gjcs, per-mille
  atk_interval  REAL,                       -- gjjl, seconds
  crit_dmg_base REAL,                       -- csys, per-mille
  max_level     INTEGER,
  grid_x        INTEGER,
  grid_y        INTEGER,
  atk_growth    REAL,                       -- ATK growth per level, per-mille
  hp_growth     REAL,                       -- HP growth per level, per-mille
  trait         TEXT,                       -- class this unit contributes
  notes         TEXT,
  dialogue      TEXT,                       -- JSON array of in-game lines
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT                        -- verified|reported|inferred|unknown
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_levels (
  hero_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  level       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  shard_cost  INTEGER,                      -- shards needed to reach the NEXT level
  atk_growth  REAL,                         -- per-mille of base ATK
  hp_growth   REAL,                         -- per-mille of base HP
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (hero_id, level)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS traits (
  cls         TEXT NOT NULL,
  breakpoint  INTEGER NOT NULL,             -- units required (or stars for Sovereign)
  mode        TEXT DEFAULT 'units',         -- units|stars
  effect      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect_kind TEXT,                         -- flat_hp|flat_atk|atk_speed_pct|crit|thorn|damage_pct
  effect_value REAL,
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (cls, breakpoint)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trick_cards (
  ref_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  quality       INTEGER,
  trigger       TEXT,
  trigger_value INTEGER,
  target_rule   TEXT,
  target_count  INTEGER,
  effect        TEXT,
  effect_args   TEXT,
  growth_field  TEXT,
  duration_ms   INTEGER,
  max_per_battle INTEGER,
  max_level     INTEGER,
  desc_en       TEXT,
  desc_zh       TEXT,
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
  slug      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect    TEXT,
  source    TEXT,
  confidence TEXT
);

-- A team is a named 10-slot board plus its hero levels.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teams (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_slots (
  team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,                -- 0..9  (0-4 front row, 5-9 back row)
  hero_id INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level   INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (team_id, slot)
);

-- Saved opponent boards used by the simulator as the calibrated meta.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_boards (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_board_slots (
  board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meta_boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hero_id  INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (board_id, slot)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sim_runs (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  label       TEXT,
  params      TEXT,                          -- JSON
  result      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

-- Training app: per-card quiz progress and streak.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_progress (
  card_key    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,             -- hero ref_id or trick ref_id
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL,                -- hero|trick
  seen        INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  wrong       INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  streak      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  best_streak INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_seen   TEXT,
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_sessions (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  started_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  finished_at TEXT,
  mode        TEXT,
  score       INTEGER,
  total       INTEGER,
  detail      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hero_cls ON heroes(cls);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_slots_team ON team_slots(team_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meta_slots ON meta_board_slots(board_id);

-- Dross Lair — Don't Die: SurvivalAutoBattler data model
-- Every value carries provenance. Nothing is silently invented.

PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heroes (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  ref_id        TEXT UNIQUE,                -- game config id (wj1001)
  key           TEXT,                       -- game config key (LvBu)
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  aliases       TEXT,                       -- JSON array of alternative names
  cls           TEXT,                       -- Warrior|Mage|Archer|Assassin|Support|Sovereign|Pouch|None
  prof_id       INTEGER,
  subrole       TEXT,                       -- Carry|Amplifier|Body|Tank|Economy|unknown
  cost          INTEGER,                    -- shop cost (1-5), NULL if unknown
  rarity        INTEGER,                    -- star tier 1-6
  rarity_name   TEXT,
  star          INTEGER DEFAULT 5,          -- star level 1-5 (sxjc bonus)
  base_atk      REAL,                       -- L1 ATK (csgj)
  base_hp       REAL,                       -- L1 HP (cssm)
  atk_speed     REAL,                       -- gjcs, per-mille
  atk_interval  REAL,                       -- gjjl, seconds
  crit_dmg_base REAL,                       -- csys, per-mille
  max_level     INTEGER,
  grid_x        INTEGER,
  grid_y        INTEGER,
  atk_growth    REAL,                       -- ATK growth per level, per-mille
  hp_growth     REAL,                       -- HP growth per level, per-mille
  trait         TEXT,                       -- class this unit contributes
  notes         TEXT,
  dialogue      TEXT,                       -- JSON array of in-game lines
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT                        -- verified|reported|inferred|unknown
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_levels (
  hero_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  level       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  shard_cost  INTEGER,                      -- shards needed to reach the NEXT level
  atk_growth  REAL,                         -- per-mille of base ATK
  hp_growth   REAL,                         -- per-mille of base HP
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (hero_id, level)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS traits (
  cls         TEXT NOT NULL,
  breakpoint  INTEGER NOT NULL,             -- units required (or stars for Sovereign)
  mode        TEXT DEFAULT 'units',         -- units|stars
  effect      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect_kind TEXT,                         -- flat_hp|flat_atk|atk_speed_pct|crit|thorn|damage_pct
  effect_value REAL,
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (cls, breakpoint)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trick_cards (
  ref_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  quality       INTEGER,
  trigger       TEXT,
  trigger_value INTEGER,
  target_rule   TEXT,
  target_count  INTEGER,
  effect        TEXT,
  effect_args   TEXT,
  growth_field  TEXT,
  duration_ms   INTEGER,
  max_per_battle INTEGER,
  max_level     INTEGER,
  desc_en       TEXT,
  desc_zh       TEXT,
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
  slug      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect    TEXT,
  source    TEXT,
  confidence TEXT
);

-- A team is a named 10-slot board plus its hero levels.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teams (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_slots (
  team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,                -- 0..9  (0-4 front row, 5-9 back row)
  hero_id INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level   INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (team_id, slot)
);

-- Saved opponent boards used by the simulator as the calibrated meta.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_boards (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_board_slots (
  board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meta_boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hero_id  INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (board_id, slot)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sim_runs (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  label       TEXT,
  params      TEXT,                          -- JSON
  result      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

-- Training app: per-card quiz progress and streak.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_progress (
  card_key    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,             -- hero ref_id or trick ref_id
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL,                -- hero|trick
  seen        INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  wrong       INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  streak      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  best_streak INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_seen   TEXT,
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_sessions (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  started_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  finished_at TEXT,
  mode        TEXT,
  score       INTEGER,
  total       INTEGER,
  detail      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hero_cls ON heroes(cls);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_slots_team ON team_slots(team_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meta_slots ON meta_board_slots(board_id);

content.text:
-- Dross Lair — Don't Die: SurvivalAutoBattler data model
-- Every value carries provenance. Nothing is silently invented.

PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heroes (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  ref_id        TEXT UNIQUE,                -- game config id (wj1001)
  key           TEXT,                       -- game config key (LvBu)
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  aliases       TEXT,                       -- JSON array of alternative names
  cls           TEXT,                       -- Warrior|Mage|Archer|Assassin|Support|Sovereign|Pouch|None
  prof_id       INTEGER,
  subrole       TEXT,                       -- Carry|Amplifier|Body|Tank|Economy|unknown
  cost          INTEGER,                    -- shop cost (1-5), NULL if unknown
  rarity        INTEGER,                    -- star tier 1-6
  rarity_name   TEXT,
  star          INTEGER DEFAULT 5,          -- star level 1-5 (sxjc bonus)
  base_atk      REAL,                       -- L1 ATK (csgj)
  base_hp       REAL,                       -- L1 HP (cssm)
  atk_speed     REAL,                       -- gjcs, per-mille
  atk_interval  REAL,                       -- gjjl, seconds
  crit_dmg_base REAL,                       -- csys, per-mille
  max_level     INTEGER,
  grid_x        INTEGER,
  grid_y        INTEGER,
  atk_growth    REAL,                       -- ATK growth per level, per-mille
  hp_growth     REAL,                       -- HP growth per level, per-mille
  trait         TEXT,                       -- class this unit contributes
  notes         TEXT,
  dialogue      TEXT,                       -- JSON array of in-game lines
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT                        -- verified|reported|inferred|unknown
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_levels (
  hero_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  level       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  shard_cost  INTEGER,                      -- shards needed to reach the NEXT level
  atk_growth  REAL,                         -- per-mille of base ATK
  hp_growth   REAL,                         -- per-mille of base HP
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (hero_id, level)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS traits (
  cls         TEXT NOT NULL,
  breakpoint  INTEGER NOT NULL,             -- units required (or stars for Sovereign)
  mode        TEXT DEFAULT 'units',         -- units|stars
  effect      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect_kind TEXT,                         -- flat_hp|flat_atk|atk_speed_pct|crit|thorn|damage_pct
  effect_value REAL,
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (cls, breakpoint)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trick_cards (
  ref_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  quality       INTEGER,
  trigger       TEXT,
  trigger_value INTEGER,
  target_rule   TEXT,
  target_count  INTEGER,
  effect        TEXT,
  effect_args   TEXT,
  growth_field  TEXT,
  duration_ms   INTEGER,
  max_per_battle INTEGER,
  max_level     INTEGER,
  desc_en       TEXT,
  desc_zh       TEXT,
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
  slug      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect    TEXT,
  source    TEXT,
  confidence TEXT
);

-- A team is a named 10-slot board plus its hero levels.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teams (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_slots (
  team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,                -- 0..9  (0-4 front row, 5-9 back row)
  hero_id INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level   INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (team_id, slot)
);

-- Saved opponent boards used by the simulator as the calibrated meta.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_boards (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_board_slots (
  board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meta_boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hero_id  INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (board_id, slot)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sim_runs (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  label       TEXT,
  params      TEXT,                          -- JSON
  result      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

-- Training app: per-card quiz progress and streak.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_progress (
  card_key    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,             -- hero ref_id or trick ref_id
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL,                -- hero|trick
  seen        INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  wrong       INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  streak      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  best_streak INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_seen   TEXT,
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_sessions (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  started_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  finished_at TEXT,
  mode        TEXT,
  score       INTEGER,
  total       INTEGER,
  detail      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hero_cls ON heroes(cls);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_slots_team ON team_slots(team_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meta_slots ON meta_board_slots(board_id);

def _target_for(unit, enemy_units):
    """Pick a target from the opposing team's living units.

    ASSUMPTION (see ASSUMPTIONS['targeting']): the attacker hits the enemy in
    the FRONT row, nearest by grid distance, lowest HP as tie-break; if the
    front row is empty it hits the back row.
    """
    alive = [u for u in enemy_units if u.alive]
    if not alive:
        return None
    front = [u for u in alive if u.slot in FRONT_SLOTS]
    pool = front if front else alive
    # nearest by grid distance, lowest HP as tie-break
    return min(pool, key=lambda u: (abs(u.grid_x - unit.grid_x) + abs(u.grid_y - unit.grid_y), u.hp))

def battle(team_a, team_b, seed=0, length=32.0, dt=0.25):
    """Tick-based battle. Returns a result dict."""
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    for u in team_a.units + team_b.units:
        u.hp = u.max_hp

    thorn_a = team_a.bonds.get("Support", {}).get("thorn", 0.0)
    thorn_b = team_b.bonds.get("Support", {}).get("thorn", 0.0)

    # Which side acts first within a tick is randomised from the seed, so a
    # mirror matchup is not biased toward whoever was passed in as team A.
    a_first = rnd.random() < 0.5

        if not a_first:
            order = tuple(reversed(order))
        for attacker, enemy, dmul, thorn in order:
            attacker = attacker.units
            enemy = enemy.units

-- Dross Lair — Don't Die: SurvivalAutoBattler data model
-- Every value carries provenance. Nothing is silently invented.

PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heroes (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  ref_id        TEXT UNIQUE,                -- game config id (wj1001)
  key           TEXT,                       -- game config key (LvBu)
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  aliases       TEXT,                       -- JSON array of alternative names
  cls           TEXT,                       -- Warrior|Mage|Archer|Assassin|Support|Sovereign|Pouch|None
  prof_id       INTEGER,
  subrole       TEXT,                       -- Carry|Amplifier|Body|Tank|Economy|unknown
  cost          INTEGER,                    -- shop cost (1-5), NULL if unknown
  rarity        INTEGER,                    -- rarity id 3-6 (Rare/Epic/Legend/Mythic)
  rarity_name   TEXT,
  rarity_tier   INTEGER,                    -- level-curve tier (same axis: 3-6)
  star          INTEGER DEFAULT 1,          -- star applied when placed (heroStar bonus)
  base_atk      REAL,                       -- L1 ATK (csgj)
  base_hp       REAL,                       -- L1 HP (cssm)
  atk_speed     REAL,                       -- gjcs, per-mille
  atk_interval  REAL,                       -- gjjl, seconds
  crit_dmg_base REAL,                       -- csys, per-mille
  max_level     INTEGER,
  grid_x        INTEGER,
  grid_y        INTEGER,
  atk_growth    REAL,                       -- ATK growth per level, per-mille
  hp_growth     REAL,                       -- HP growth per level, per-mille
  trait         TEXT,                       -- class this unit contributes
  notes         TEXT,
  dialogue      TEXT,                       -- JSON array of in-game lines
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT                        -- verified|reported|inferred|unknown
);

-- The game's star bonus table (heroStar). sxjc is per-mille on both ATK and HP.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS star_levels (
  star         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,          -- 1..5
  atk_hp_bonus REAL,                         -- per-mille
  source       TEXT,
  confidence   TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_levels (
  hero_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  level       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  shard_cost  INTEGER,                      -- shards needed to reach the NEXT level
  atk_growth  REAL,                         -- per-mille of base ATK
  hp_growth   REAL,                         -- per-mille of base HP
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (hero_id, level)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS traits (
  cls         TEXT NOT NULL,
  breakpoint  INTEGER NOT NULL,             -- units required (or stars for Sovereign)
  mode        TEXT DEFAULT 'units',         -- units|stars
  effect      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect_kind TEXT,                         -- flat_hp|flat_atk|atk_speed_pct|crit|thorn|damage_pct
  effect_value REAL,
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (cls, breakpoint)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trick_cards (
  ref_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  quality       INTEGER,
  trigger       TEXT,
  trigger_value INTEGER,
  target_rule   TEXT,
  target_count  INTEGER,
  effect        TEXT,
  effect_args   TEXT,
  growth_field  TEXT,
  duration_ms   INTEGER,
  max_per_battle INTEGER,
  max_level     INTEGER,
  desc_en       TEXT,
  desc_zh       TEXT,
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
  slug      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect    TEXT,
  source    TEXT,
  confidence TEXT
);

-- A team is a named 10-slot board plus its hero levels.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teams (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_slots (
  team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,                -- 0..9  (0-4 front row, 5-9 back row)
  hero_id INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level   INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  star    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,                -- star level of this placed unit (1..5)
  PRIMARY KEY (team_id, slot)
);

-- Saved opponent boards used by the simulator as the calibrated meta.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_boards (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_board_slots (
  board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meta_boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hero_id  INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (board_id, slot)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sim_runs (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  label       TEXT,
  params      TEXT,                          -- JSON
  result      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

-- Training app: per-card quiz progress and streak.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_progress (
  card_key    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,             -- hero ref_id or trick ref_id
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL,                -- hero|trick
  seen        INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  wrong       INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  streak      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  best_streak INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_seen   TEXT,
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_sessions (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  started_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  finished_at TEXT,
  mode        TEXT,
  score       INTEGER,
  total       INTEGER,
  detail      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hero_cls ON heroes(cls);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_slots_team ON team_slots(team_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meta_slots ON meta_board_slots(board_id);

def team_rows(con, team_id):
    """Placed units for a team.

    The slot's own `star` is what the player set, so it must win over the
    hero row's default `star`. Both are named explicitly to avoid the
    ambiguous duplicate-column-name trap of `h.*`.
    """
    out = []
    for r in con.execute(
            "SELECT s.slot, s.level, s.star AS slot_star, h.* FROM team_slots s "
            "LEFT JOIN heroes h ON h.id=s.hero_id WHERE s.team_id=? ORDER BY s.slot",
            (team_id,)):
        d = dict(r)
        d["star"] = d.pop("slot_star") or 1
        out.append(d)
    return out

def save_team_slots(con, team_id, slots, replace=False):
    """Persist placed units.

    Partial mode (default) upserts the listed slots: a slot with a null
    hero_id is removed. Replace mode wipes the board first, then writes the
    given slots — that is what "save this board" means.
    """
    if replace:
        con.execute("DELETE FROM team_slots WHERE team_id=?", (team_id,))
    for slot in slots:
        con.execute("DELETE FROM team_slots WHERE team_id=? AND slot=?", (team_id, slot["slot"]))
        if slot.get("hero_id"):
            con.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO team_slots (team_id,slot,hero_id,level,star) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                (team_id, slot["slot"], slot["hero_id"], slot.get("level", 1), slot.get("star", 1)))
    con.execute("UPDATE teams SET updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE id=?", (team_id,))


def rename_team(con, team_id, name, notes=None):
    """Rename an existing team in place. Returns the team id."""
    con.execute("UPDATE teams SET name=?, notes=COALESCE(?,notes), "
                "updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE id=?", (name, notes, team_id))
    return team_id

edits.newText:
-- A hero's skills. Skill identifiers and milestones come from heroSkillLevel;
-- names, descriptions, level descriptions and parameters come from
-- battleSkillRef. One row per (hero, skill).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_skills (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  hero_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  ref_id     TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- battleSkillRef id (KongRongMain)
  kind       TEXT,                          -- mainSkill|initSkill|maxSkill|lv3|lv6
  milestones TEXT,                          -- JSON array of unlock levels

def save_team_slots(con, team_id, slots, replace=False):
    """Persist the board.

    The posted slot list IS the board: every slot not mentioned is cleared.
    A slot with a null hero_id is cleared. This keeps the server from ever
    holding a board that disagrees with what the player sees.
    """
    con.execute("DELETE FROM team_slots WHERE team_id=?", (team_id,))
    for slot in slots:
        if not slot.get("hero_id"):
            continue
        con.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO team_slots (team_id,slot,hero_id,level,star) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
            (team_id, slot["slot"], slot["hero_id"], slot.get("level", 1), slot.get("star", 1)))
    con.execute("UPDATE teams SET updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE id=?", (team_id,))
edits.oldText:
def save_team_slots(con, team_id, slots, replace=False):
    """Persist placed units.

    Partial mode (default) upserts the listed slots: a slot with a null
    hero_id is removed. Replace mode wipes the board first, then writes the
    given slots — that is what "save this board" means.
    """
    if replace:
        con.execute("DELETE FROM team_slots WHERE team_id=?", (team_id,))
    for slot in slots:
        con.execute("DELETE FROM team_slots WHERE team_id=? AND slot=?", (team_id, slot["slot"]))
        if slot.get("hero_id"):
            con.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO team_slots (team_id,slot,hero_id,level,star) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                (team_id, slot["slot"], slot["hero_id"], slot.get("level", 1), slot.get("star", 1)))
    con.execute("UPDATE teams SET updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE id=?", (team_id,))

# Questions are generated and graded in the same server process, so the
# expected answer is kept here keyed by qid. The client never decides whether
# it was right.
_QUESTIONS = {}
_qid_seq = [0]


def _register(q):
    """Stamp a question with an id and remember its answer."""
    _qid_seq[0] += 1
    qid = "q%d" % _qid_seq[0]
    q["qid"] = qid
    q["id"] = qid
    q["_expected"] = q.get("answer")
    _QUESTIONS[qid] = q
    return q

-- Dross Lair — Don't Die: SurvivalAutoBattler data model
-- Every value carries provenance. Nothing is silently invented.

PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heroes (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  ref_id        TEXT UNIQUE,                -- game config id (wj1001)
  key           TEXT,                       -- game config key (LvBu)
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  aliases       TEXT,                       -- JSON array of alternative names
  cls           TEXT,                       -- Warrior|Mage|Archer|Assassin|Support|Sovereign|Pouch|None
  prof_id       INTEGER,
  subrole       TEXT,                       -- Carry|Amplifier|Body|Tank|Economy|unknown
  cost          INTEGER,                    -- shop cost (1-5), NULL if unknown
  rarity        INTEGER,                    -- rarity id 3-6 (Rare/Epic/Legend/Mythic)
  rarity_name   TEXT,
  rarity_tier   INTEGER,                    -- level-curve tier (same axis: 3-6)
  star          INTEGER DEFAULT 1,          -- star applied when placed (heroStar bonus)
  base_atk      REAL,                       -- L1 ATK (csgj)
  base_hp       REAL,                       -- L1 HP (cssm)
  atk_speed     REAL,                       -- gjcs, per-mille
  atk_interval  REAL,                       -- gjjl, seconds
  crit_dmg_base REAL,                       -- csys, per-mille
  max_level     INTEGER,
  grid_x        INTEGER,
  grid_y        INTEGER,
  atk_growth    REAL,                       -- ATK growth per level, per-mille
  hp_growth     REAL,                       -- HP growth per level, per-mille
  trait         TEXT,                       -- class this unit contributes
  notes         TEXT,
  dialogue      TEXT,                       -- JSON array of in-game lines
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT                        -- verified|reported|inferred|unknown
);

-- A hero's skills. Skill identifiers and milestones come from heroSkillLevel;
-- names, descriptions, level descriptions and parameters come from
-- battleSkillRef. One row per (hero, skill).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_skills (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  hero_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  ref_id     TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- battleSkillRef id (KongRongMain)
  kind       TEXT,                          -- mainSkill|initSkill|maxSkill|lv3|lv6
  milestones TEXT,                          -- JSON array of unlock levels
  levels     TEXT,                          -- JSON array of skill levels
  name_zh    TEXT,
  name_en    TEXT,
  desc_zh    TEXT,                          -- JSON array
  desc_en    TEXT,                          -- JSON array
  lvdesc_zh  TEXT,                          -- JSON array, one per level
  lvdesc_en  TEXT,                          -- JSON array, one per level
  params     TEXT,                          -- JSON object of parameters
  source     TEXT,
  confidence TEXT
);

-- The game's star bonus table (heroStar). sxjc is per-mille on both ATK and HP.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS star_levels (
  star         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,          -- 1..5
  atk_hp_bonus REAL,                         -- per-mille
  source       TEXT,
  confidence   TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_levels (
  hero_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  level       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  shard_cost  INTEGER,                      -- shards needed to reach the NEXT level
  atk_growth  REAL,                         -- per-mille of base ATK
  hp_growth   REAL,                         -- per-mille of base HP
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (hero_id, level)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS traits (
  cls         TEXT NOT NULL,
  breakpoint  INTEGER NOT NULL,             -- units required (or stars for Sovereign)
  mode        TEXT DEFAULT 'units',         -- units|stars
  effect      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect_kind TEXT,                         -- flat_hp|flat_atk|atk_speed_pct|crit|thorn|damage_pct
  effect_value REAL,
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (cls, breakpoint)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trick_cards (
  ref_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  quality       INTEGER,
  trigger       TEXT,
  trigger_value INTEGER,
  target_rule   TEXT,
  target_count  INTEGER,
  effect        TEXT,
  effect_args   TEXT,
  growth_field  TEXT,
  duration_ms   INTEGER,
  max_per_battle INTEGER,
  max_level     INTEGER,
  desc_en       TEXT,
  desc_zh       TEXT,
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
  slug      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect    TEXT,
  source    TEXT,
  confidence TEXT
);

-- A team is a named 10-slot board plus its hero levels.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teams (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_slots (
  team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,                -- 0..9  (0-4 front row, 5-9 back row)
  hero_id INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level   INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  star    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,                -- star level of this placed unit (1..5)
  PRIMARY KEY (team_id, slot)
);

-- Saved opponent boards used by the simulator as the calibrated meta.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_boards (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_board_slots (
  board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meta_boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hero_id  INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (board_id, slot)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sim_runs (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  label       TEXT,
  params      TEXT,                          -- JSON
  result      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

-- Training app: per-card quiz progress and streak.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_progress (
  card_key    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,             -- hero ref_id or trick ref_id
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL,                -- hero|trick|bond|stats|shards
  seen        INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  wrong       INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  streak      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  best_streak INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_seen   TEXT,
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- Every graded answer, so a session can be reconstructed after the fact.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_attempts (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id  TEXT,
  qid         TEXT,
  card_key    TEXT,
  kind        TEXT,
  given       TEXT,
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_sessions (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id  TEXT,                          -- client-supplied session handle
  started_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  finished_at TEXT,
  mode        TEXT,
  score       INTEGER,                       -- number correct
  total       INTEGER,                       -- number answered
  attempts    INTEGER DEFAULT 0,             -- same as total, named for the UI
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,             -- same as score
  detail      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hero_cls ON heroes(cls);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_skills_hero ON hero_skills(hero_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attempts_session ON drill_attempts(session_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_slots_team ON team_slots(team_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meta_slots ON meta_board_slots(board_id);

# 2026-10-25 — DDAB simulator: fix pass, verification, card docs (01:00–01:15)
- `~/Projects/ddab-sim/` — DB rebuilt from scratch against rewritten `schema.sql`:
  56 heroes, 211 hero_skills rows, 1176 hero_levels rows, 17 traits, 36 trick_cards, 5 star_levels.
- **E2E now PASS 84 / FAIL 0** (`tools/e2e_test.py`). Was PASS 65 / FAIL 12.
- Fixes that closed the 12 failures:
  - `shard_plan` read `atk_growth`/`hp_growth` off the wrong level row -> now uses
    `compute_stats` with the hero's own board, and `heroes` rows are dicts not `sqlite3.Row`.
  - `/api/hero` now returns `skills`; `hero_skills()` parses the JSON columns into real lists.
  - `save_team_slots` now treats the posted list as the whole board (delete + reinsert).
  - `/api/team` with `new_name` now renames in place via `rename_team` (was creating a duplicate).
  - `battle()` returns `winner` + `units_a`/`units_b`; `matchup()` returns `wins_a`/`wins_b`.
  - Training: questions carry `qid`; answers are graded server-side (expected answer is
    looked up from the question the server issued, never trusted from the client);
    `drill_attempts` rows recorded; `drill_sessions` totals come from recorded attempts.
- **Data findings (authoritative gaps, documented not invented):**
  - `wj1112` HeiXiong/Black Bear: in `heroRef` but ZERO stats and no `heroSkillLevel` rows.

);

edits.newText:
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- RUN MODE
-- A run is one endless-survival attempt: waves of enemies, a roster that
-- persists across them, and the player's own HP (init_hp) as the fail state.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  seed          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  day           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,     -- wave number
  hp            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,      -- player HP (init_hp)
  max_hp        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,
  gold          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15,     -- init_coin
  shards        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  refresh_cost  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,      -- init_refresh
  board_size    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,      -- init_slot, grows per wave
  status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',  -- active|dead|complete
  created_at    TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at    TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- The roster. Units persist for the whole run: they carry their wounded HP
-- into the next wave and come back from a knockdown, so nothing is ever lost
-- permanently. That is the "don't die" contract of the mode.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_units (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pos         INTEGER NOT NULL,                 -- roster order
  hero_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  star        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  hp          REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,          -- carried HP between waves
  max_hp      REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  boarded     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,       -- on the board vs on the bench
  kills       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  downs       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- times knocked down
  UNIQUE (run_id, pos)
);

-- The shop offers for the current wave. hero_pick / selectHeroNum = 3.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_shop (
  run_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,                     -- 0..2
  hero_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id),
  taken   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, slot)
);

-- One row per wave fought, so a run can be reconstructed after the fact.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_waves (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  day        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  result     TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- win|loss
  boss       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  summary    TEXT,                              -- JSON
  log        TEXT,                              -- JSON
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hero_cls ON heroes(cls);

def connect(path=None, shared=False):
    p = Path(path or DB_PATH)
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # A shared connection is reused across the server's worker threads. SQLite
    # objects are thread-bound by default, and the server serialises access with
    # its own lock, so the thread check has to be relaxed for that one case.
    con = sqlite3.connect(p, check_same_thread=not shared)
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    con.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    con.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000")
    return con

def battle(team_a, team_b, seed=0, length=32.0, dt=0.25, preserve_hp=False):
    """Tick-based battle. Returns a result dict.

    preserve_hp=True keeps each unit's current HP instead of starting it at
    full. That is what the run mode needs: a unit carries the wounds it took
    last wave into this one. A unit at 0 HP is treated as already down.
    """
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    for u in team_a.units + team_b.units:
        if preserve_hp:
            u.hp = max(0.0, min(u.hp, u.max_hp))
            u.alive = u.hp > 0
        else:
            u.hp = u.max_hp
            u.alive = True
        u.cd = 0.0

import re
p='dross/server.py'
s=open(p).read()

# 1. one shared connection, initialised once
s = s.replace(
"""_lock = threading.Lock()""",
"""# One shared connection for the whole process. Every request used to open its
# own connection and never close it: that leaked file descriptors, and because
# init_db() runs DDL on each call it left an open write transaction on the
# leaked handle, so the first write after a few reads failed with
# "database is locked". The lock is reentrant so the nested `with _lock`
# blocks below still work once the whole handler is guarded.
_lock = threading.RLock()

_con = None


def _db():
    \"\"\"The single shared, initialised database connection.\"\"\"
    global _con
    if _con is None:
        _con = db.connect(shared=True)
        db.init_db(_con)
    return _con""")

# 2. every per-request connect/init becomes the shared connection
s = s.replace("""                    con = db.connect()
                    db.init_db(con)
""", """                    con = _db()
""")
s = s.replace("""                con = db.connect()
                db.init_db(con)
""", """                con = _db()
""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('remaining db.connect calls:', s.count('db.connect()'))
print('remaining init_db calls:', s.count('db.init_db'))
EOF

That sweep is the most important diagnostic of the session. Two hard findings:

- **Equal power = exactly 50%** (22/60 as team A + 38/60 as team B = 60/120). The sim is fair, no order bias.
- **One level of enemy advantage collapses it to ~8%** (board 3) or ~20% (board 8). A +10% HP / +5% ATK edge is far too decisive.

So level is a knife-edge knob, not a dial — I can't tune difficulty with integer levels. Before I pick a finer control, let me ground the HP economy in the shipped endless-mode config, which I haven't fully read yet.

So level is a knife-edge knob, not a dial — I can't tune difficulty with integer levels. Before I pick a finer control, let me ground the HP economy in the shipped endless-mode config, which I haven't fully read yet.

-- Dross Lair — Don't Die: SurvivalAutoBattler data model
-- Every value carries provenance. Nothing is silently invented.

PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heroes (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  ref_id        TEXT UNIQUE,                -- game config id (wj1001)
  key           TEXT,                       -- game config key (LvBu)
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  aliases       TEXT,                       -- JSON array of alternative names
  cls           TEXT,                       -- Warrior|Mage|Archer|Assassin|Support|Sovereign|Pouch|None
  prof_id       INTEGER,
  subrole       TEXT,                       -- Carry|Amplifier|Body|Tank|Economy|unknown
  cost          INTEGER,                    -- shop cost (1-5), NULL if unknown
  rarity        INTEGER,                    -- rarity id 3-6 (Rare/Epic/Legend/Mythic)
  rarity_name   TEXT,
  rarity_tier   INTEGER,                    -- level-curve tier (same axis: 3-6)
  star          INTEGER DEFAULT 1,          -- star applied when placed (heroStar bonus)
  base_atk      REAL,                       -- L1 ATK (csgj)
  base_hp       REAL,                       -- L1 HP (cssm)
  atk_speed     REAL,                       -- gjcs, per-mille
  atk_interval  REAL,                       -- gjjl, seconds
  crit_dmg_base REAL,                       -- csys, per-mille
  max_level     INTEGER,
  grid_x        INTEGER,
  grid_y        INTEGER,
  atk_growth    REAL,                       -- ATK growth per level, per-mille
  hp_growth     REAL,                       -- HP growth per level, per-mille
  trait         TEXT,                       -- class this unit contributes
  notes         TEXT,
  dialogue      TEXT,                       -- JSON array of in-game lines
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT                        -- verified|reported|inferred|unknown
);

-- A hero's skills. Skill identifiers and milestones come from heroSkillLevel;
-- names, descriptions, level descriptions and parameters come from
-- battleSkillRef. One row per (hero, skill).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_skills (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  hero_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  ref_id     TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- battleSkillRef id (KongRongMain)
  kind       TEXT,                          -- mainSkill|initSkill|maxSkill|lv3|lv6
  milestones TEXT,                          -- JSON array of unlock levels
  levels     TEXT,                          -- JSON array of skill levels
  name_zh    TEXT,
  name_en    TEXT,
  desc_zh    TEXT,                          -- JSON array
  desc_en    TEXT,                          -- JSON array
  lvdesc_zh  TEXT,                          -- JSON array, one per level
  lvdesc_en  TEXT,                          -- JSON array, one per level
  params     TEXT,                          -- JSON object of parameters
  source     TEXT,
  confidence TEXT
);

-- The game's star bonus table (heroStar). sxjc is per-mille on both ATK and HP.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS star_levels (
  star         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,          -- 1..5
  atk_hp_bonus REAL,                         -- per-mille
  source       TEXT,
  confidence   TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hero_levels (
  hero_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  level       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  shard_cost  INTEGER,                      -- shards needed to reach the NEXT level
  atk_growth  REAL,                         -- per-mille of base ATK
  hp_growth   REAL,                         -- per-mille of base HP
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (hero_id, level)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS traits (
  cls         TEXT NOT NULL,
  breakpoint  INTEGER NOT NULL,             -- units required (or stars for Sovereign)
  mode        TEXT DEFAULT 'units',         -- units|stars
  effect      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect_kind TEXT,                         -- flat_hp|flat_atk|atk_speed_pct|crit|thorn|damage_pct
  effect_value REAL,
  source      TEXT,
  confidence  TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (cls, breakpoint)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trick_cards (
  ref_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  name_zh       TEXT,
  quality       INTEGER,
  trigger       TEXT,
  trigger_value INTEGER,
  target_rule   TEXT,
  target_count  INTEGER,
  effect        TEXT,
  effect_args   TEXT,
  growth_field  TEXT,
  duration_ms   INTEGER,
  max_per_battle INTEGER,
  max_level     INTEGER,
  desc_en       TEXT,
  desc_zh       TEXT,
  source        TEXT,
  confidence    TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
  slug      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect    TEXT,
  source    TEXT,
  confidence TEXT
);

-- A team is a named 10-slot board plus its hero levels.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teams (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_slots (
  team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,                -- 0..9  (0-4 front row, 5-9 back row)
  hero_id INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level   INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  star    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,                -- star level of this placed unit (1..5)
  PRIMARY KEY (team_id, slot)
);

-- Saved opponent boards used by the simulator as the calibrated meta.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_boards (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_board_slots (
  board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meta_boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hero_id  INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (board_id, slot)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sim_runs (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  label       TEXT,
  params      TEXT,                          -- JSON
  result      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

-- Training app: per-card quiz progress and streak.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_progress (
  card_key    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,             -- hero ref_id or trick ref_id
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL,                -- hero|trick|bond|stats|shards
  seen        INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  wrong       INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  streak      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  best_streak INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_seen   TEXT,
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- Every graded answer, so a session can be reconstructed after the fact.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_attempts (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id  TEXT,
  qid         TEXT,
  card_key    TEXT,
  kind        TEXT,
  given       TEXT,
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_sessions (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id  TEXT,                          -- client-supplied session handle
  started_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  finished_at TEXT,
  mode        TEXT,
  score       INTEGER,                       -- number correct
  total       INTEGER,                       -- number answered
  attempts    INTEGER DEFAULT 0,             -- same as total, named for the UI
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,             -- same as score
  detail      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- RUN MODE
-- A run is one endless-survival attempt: waves of enemies, a roster that
-- persists across them, and the player's own HP (init_hp) as the fail state.

  name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  effect    TEXT,
  source    TEXT,
  confidence TEXT
);

-- A team is a named 10-slot board plus its hero levels.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teams (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_slots (
  team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,                -- 0..9  (0-4 front row, 5-9 back row)
  hero_id INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level   INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  star    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,                -- star level of this placed unit (1..5)
  PRIMARY KEY (team_id, slot)
);

-- Saved opponent boards used by the simulator as the calibrated meta.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_boards (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_board_slots (
  board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES meta_boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hero_id  INTEGER REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level    INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (board_id, slot)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sim_runs (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  label       TEXT,
  params      TEXT,                          -- JSON
  result      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

-- Training app: per-card quiz progress and streak.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_progress (
  card_key    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,             -- hero ref_id or trick ref_id
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL,                -- hero|trick|bond|stats|shards
  seen        INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  wrong       INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  streak      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  best_streak INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_seen   TEXT,
  updated_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- Every graded answer, so a session can be reconstructed after the fact.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_attempts (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id  TEXT,
  qid         TEXT,
  card_key    TEXT,
  kind        TEXT,
  given       TEXT,
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drill_sessions (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id  TEXT,                          -- client-supplied session handle
  started_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  finished_at TEXT,
  mode        TEXT,
  score       INTEGER,                       -- number correct
  total       INTEGER,                       -- number answered
  attempts    INTEGER DEFAULT 0,             -- same as total, named for the UI
  correct     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,             -- same as score
  detail      TEXT                           -- JSON
);

-- A run is one endless-survival attempt: waves of enemies, a roster that
-- persists across them, and the player's own HP (init_hp) as the fail state.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  seed          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  day           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,     -- wave number
  hp            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,      -- player HP (init_hp)
  max_hp        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,
  gold          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15,     -- init_coin
  shards        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  refresh_cost  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,      -- init_refresh
  board_size    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,      -- init_slot, grows per wave
  status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',  -- active|dead|complete
  created_at    TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at    TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- The roster. Units persist for the whole run: they carry their wounded HP
-- into the next wave and come back from a knockdown, so nothing is ever lost
-- permanently. That is the "don't die" contract of the mode.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_units (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pos         INTEGER NOT NULL,                 -- roster order
  hero_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  star        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  hp          REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,          -- carried HP between waves
  max_hp      REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  boarded     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,       -- on the board vs on the bench
  kills       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  downs       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- times knocked down
  UNIQUE (run_id, pos)
);

-- The shop offers for the current wave. hero_pick / selectHeroNum = 3.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_shop (
  run_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,                     -- 0..2
  hero_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id),
  taken   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, slot)
);

-- One row per wave fought, so a run can be reconstructed after the fact.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_waves (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  day        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  result     TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- win|loss
  boss       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  summary    TEXT,                              -- JSON
  log        TEXT,                              -- JSON
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hero_cls ON heroes(cls);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_skills_hero ON hero_skills(hero_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attempts_session ON drill_attempts(session_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_slots_team ON team_slots(team_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meta_slots ON meta_board_slots(board_id);

-- A run is one endless-survival attempt: waves of enemies, a roster that
-- persists across them, and the player's own HP (init_hp) as the fail state.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  seed          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  day           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,     -- wave number
  hp            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,      -- player HP (init_hp)
  max_hp        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,
  gold          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15,     -- init_coin
  shards        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  refresh_cost  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,      -- init_refresh
  board_size    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,      -- init_slot, grows per wave
  status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',  -- active|dead|complete
  created_at    TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at    TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- The roster. Units persist for the whole run: they carry their wounded HP
-- into the next wave and come back from a knockdown, so nothing is ever lost
-- permanently. That is the "don't die" contract of the mode.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_units (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pos         INTEGER NOT NULL,                 -- roster order
  hero_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id),
  level       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  star        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  hp          REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,          -- carried HP between waves
  max_hp      REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  boarded     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,       -- on the board vs on the bench
  kills       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  downs       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- times knocked down
  UNIQUE (run_id, pos)
);

-- The shop offers for the current wave. hero_pick / selectHeroNum = 3.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_shop (
  run_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot    INTEGER NOT NULL,                     -- 0..2
  hero_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES heroes(id),
  taken   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, slot)
);

-- One row per wave fought, so a run can be reconstructed after the fact.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_waves (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  day        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  result     TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- win|loss
  boss       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  summary    TEXT,                              -- JSON
  log        TEXT,                              -- JSON
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hero_cls ON heroes(cls);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_skills_hero ON hero_skills(hero_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attempts_session ON drill_attempts(session_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_slots_team ON team_slots(team_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meta_slots ON meta_board_slots(board_id);

-- A run is one endless-survival attempt: waves of enemies, a roster that
-- persists across them, and the player's own HP (init_hp) as the fail state.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  seed          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  day           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,     -- wave number
  hp            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,      -- player HP (init_hp)

"""Measure the win-rate response curve of the battle simulator.

The battle is a race: the player kills the enemy in
    T1 = enemy_total_hp / player_dps
and the enemy kills the player in
    T2 = player_total_hp / enemy_dps.
The player wins iff T1 < T2, i.e. iff

    player_hp * player_dps  >  enemy_hp * enemy_dps

so the natural difficulty knob is the PRODUCT ratio, not hp/dps.

This script measures the actual win rate as a function of a uniform stat
scale s applied to the enemy (atk and max_hp both scaled), for several board
sizes, and prints the predicted race ratio next to the observed win rate so
the two can be compared.
"""
import random
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "~/Projects/ddab-sim")

from dross import db, sim  # noqa: E402


def scale_team(team, s):
    """Uniformly scale a team's effective stats (post-bond)."""
    for u in team.units:
        u.atk *= s
        u.max_hp *= s
        u.hp = u.max_hp
    return team


def board_slots(con, n, seed=7):
    """n units: the player's real board first, then fillers with matching classes."""
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    rows = [dict(r) for r in con.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM heroes WHERE base_hp > 0 AND cls IN "
        "('Warrior','Archer','Mage','Assassin','Support','Sovereign')")]

=== schema.sql runs/run_units ===
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sim_runs (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  label       TEXT,
  params      TEXT,                          -- JSON
  result      TEXT                           -- JSON
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT NOT NULL,
  seed          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  day           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,     -- wave number
  hp            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,      -- player HP (init_hp)
  max_hp        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,
  gold          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15,     -- init_coin
  shards        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  crystals      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,      -- dj_hb003 水晶: buys shop refreshes
  refresh_cost  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,      -- init_refresh
  refreshes     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,      -- refreshes used (refreshMax cap)
  board_size    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,      -- init_slot, grows per wave
  status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',  -- active|dead|complete
  created_at    TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at    TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_units (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

);

);

args.title: Fix Row/dict handling and rerun tests
args.command:
cd ~/Projects/ddab-sim && python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('dross/run.py'); src=p.read_text()
old = '''    kind = _talent_kind(unit.get("star"))
    return _perk_param(con, unit["hero_id"], kind, unit.get("level") or 1) or {}'''
new = '''    # The unit may be a plain dict (the roster view) or a sqlite3.Row (a
    # single-row fetch), so read the fields defensively.
    if isinstance(unit, dict):
        star, level, hero_id = unit.get("star"), unit.get("level"), unit.get("hero_id")
    else:
        star = unit["star"] if "star" in unit.keys() else 1
        level = unit["level"] if "level" in unit.keys() else 1
        hero_id = unit["hero_id"]
    kind = _talent_kind(star)
    return _perk_param(con, hero_id, kind, level or 1) or {}'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(src)
print('fixed _unit_talent')
EOF
python3 -m py_compile dross/run.py && python3 tools/run_test.py 2>&1 | tail -55

      con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM heroes WHERE cost IS NOT NULL").fetchone()['c'] == 0)

EOF

args.title: Explain 53 vs 54 test count
args.command:
cd ~/Projects/ddab-sim && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, shutil, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "~/Projects/ddab-sim")
from pathlib import Path
from dross import db, run
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ddab-cnt-"))
con = db.connect(str(tmp/"t.db")); db.init_db(con)
rid = run.new_run(con, name="cnt", seed=31337)
cfg = run.mode_config()
con.execute("UPDATE run_units SET hp=0 WHERE run_id=?", (rid,))
con.execute("UPDATE runs SET hp=1 WHERE id=?", (rid,))
con.commit()
out = run.play_wave(con, rid)
st = run.run_state(con, rid)
print("after forced wave -> hp:", st["run"]["hp"], "| status:", st["run"]["status"])
print("=> the 'run is marked dead at 0 HP' check runs only when hp == 0;",
      "that is the 53 vs 54 difference (a conditional check, not a regression)")
con.close(); shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
EOF

waves are fought with carried HP and knocked-down units. So the calibration measured a
fight that never happened, and the difficulty curve was tuned to the wrong game.

**The fix (in `dross/run.py`):**
- The calibration probe now starts from the SAME carried-HP snapshot `play_wave` uses:
  survivors keep the HP they finished with, and a unit reduced to 0 HP is knocked down
  (`downs+1`) and comes back at `REVIVE_PCT` (0.30), not deleted.
- Every calibration repetition RESETS to that same starting snapshot — the probe must
  not grind HP down across repetitions.
- Enemies are always fresh, full-HP teams.
- Both boards place tankiest units in front slots 0-4 (`_formation_order`).
- The stale `RUN_ASSUMPTIONS` claim that calibration measures a full-HP player board
  was removed; the new wording is what the GUI shows.

**Enemy difficulty knobs (the ONLY things that may change difficulty):**
- `offset` — added to the shipped `ai_level`; clamped to `CALIB_OFFSETS` (-18..12).
- `scale` — stat scalar on the enemy board; `1.0` IS the shipped enemy. Higher = stronger.
- Composition, classes, ai-level ladder, seeded deck/hero selection and replay behaviour
  are all shipped and untouched.
- Search is per-offset BISECTION (the measured win rate is a CLIFF, not a slope), with
